requirements.requirement: The system must include a unit test validating that a RECRUITING status maps to the highest configured score.
The system must include a unit test validating that ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING status maps to a lower score than RECRUITING.
The system must include a unit test validating that COMPLETED status maps to a lower score than ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING.
The system must include a unit test validating that TERMINATED status maps to the lowest defined score among known statuses.
The system must include a unit test validating that UNKNOWN status maps to a default fallback score.
The system must include a unit test confirming deterministic output such that the same input status always returns the same score.
The system must include a unit test validating that status comparisons preserve correct ranking order across all defined categories.
The system must include a unit test ensuring that a null or missing status value returns the UNKNOWN fallback score without throwing an error.
The system must include a unit test ensuring that an unrecognized status string returns the UNKNOWN fallback score.
The system must include a unit test validating that status input is case-insensitive when mapping to scores.
The system must include a unit test verifying that leading or trailing whitespace in status input does not affect score mapping.
The system must include a unit test confirming that the scoring function handles empty string status input by returning the UNKNOWN fallback score.
